head: eb63fe5

rows.note: A handler that takes bodyStream(), reads one byte and throws: the adapter input is closed exactly once and the saved stream throws IOException after the cleanup (error path covered too).

skip() never advances past rawBodyLimit(1024) on an undeclared 1025-byte body; the crossing call throws BodyTooLargeException limit 1024. Observation only (no AC covers it): the access log for this request shows in=1025 because the LimitedInputStream probe byte goes through the BodyState counting stream; the JSON reader counts the same way.
Four single-byte read() calls through bodyStream(2048) of a 10-byte Content-Length body, then close(): in=4 (close and cleanup do not drain into the counter).
rawBodyLimit(10) and rawBodyLimit(0) after listen both throw IllegalStateException (guard before range check); the app keeps 1048576 and a 2000-byte body reads to its end.
A Content-Length: 0 request: first read -1, a second bodyStream() is the same object, bodyStream(2048) throws IllegalStateException.

notes: Command: ./gradlew -PtinyHttpdFromMaven=true :NaruServe-api:test --tests 'com.snoworca.naruserve.LoopPWave5Test' in a detached scratch worktree at eb63fe5: 5 tests, 0 failures.

Reviewed without a red finding: rawStream ordering (consumed/released before the limit check, 413 before exchangeInput, body.complete on 413), RawBodyStream consumption rules, closeBody release, the Dispatcher wiring at both request construction sites, the shared byteLimit range check, and the surface/lifecycle/BodyState test re-points.
